summary: Nine-metre kerb at a junction mouth; too short for a van, apartments 14 m away.
reasons: Only 9 m, shorter than a van
Junction mouth, little room to stop

best_section.where: West kerb of Moorak Street, just before the junction

drivers.seclusion: Koala Garden apartments 14 m away, houses 19-21 m on the far side; overlooked all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Stretch is 9 m and runs into the junction corner, so a van would overhang the mouth.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a junction beside it.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs; a few cars park nearby.

sun_shade: Tree canopy to the south-west shades the kerb; open to the east.
